name: LangGraph
tagline: LangGraph is a library to build resilient agents
description: LangGraph is a library to build resilient agents. Open-source software; the repository lists the licence as MIT.
useCases: Building long-running agent workflows in code
strengths: Source code and licence are public in the official repository
No licence fee for the software itself
limitations: You run and maintain it yourself, so hosting, hardware and support costs are your own
We have not run or benchmarked it

openSource.note: The official repository lists the licence as MIT

free.details: The software is free to use under its MIT licence; infrastructure and any hosted offerings are separate.

plans.name: Self-hosted (open source)
plans.note: Free software under the MIT licence; your own hosting and hardware costs apply

pricing.regional: No vendor price list. Any hosted or commercial offering from the same team is priced separately and is not covered here.

verification.notes: Project active. The repository page describes it as 'Build resilient agents.' and shows the MIT license. No pricing: open-source software.

profile.headline: An agent runtime and low-level orchestration framework

capabilities.title: Add human-in-the-loop checks
capabilities.text: Add moderation and quality controls that steer and approve agent actions.

capabilities.title: Build flexible agent workflows
capabilities.text: Low-level primitives support single-agent, multi-agent and hierarchical control flows in one framework.

capabilities.title: Remember across sessions
capabilities.text: Built-in memory stores conversation histories and keeps context.

capabilities.title: Stream what the agent is doing
capabilities.text: First-class token-by-token streaming shows reasoning and actions in real time.

featureCards.name: Human-in-the-loop
featureCards.text: Checks that approve or redirect an agent before it acts.

featureCards.name: Persistent memory
featureCards.text: Keeps context from one interaction to the next.

featureCards.name: Streaming
featureCards.text: Designed with streaming workflows in mind.

featureCards.name: LangChain Academy course
featureCards.text: An Introduction to LangGraph covers state, memory and human-in-the-loop.

audienceDetail.text: The framework is low-level by design.
The page says it serves both.
For cases where a single black-box architecture does not fit.
